# The Edvocate

> The Edvocate is an education advocacy platform by Dr. Matthew Lynch dedicated to promoting education reform, evaluating edtech products, and recognizing excellence in educational technology through awards and comprehensive product guides.

The Edvocate serves as a central hub for education technology reviews, advocacy content, and industry recognition through its Tech Edvocate Awards program. The platform encompasses multiple brands including Tech Edvocate and EdRater, offering resources for educators, administrators, and edtech companies.

## Getting Started

- [The Edvocate](https://www.theedadvocate.org): Homepage for The Edvocate education advocacy platform by Dr. Matt Lynch
- [Start Here - The Edvocate](https://www.theedadvocate.org/start-here): Getting started guide covering The Edvocate's mission and education reform advocacy
- [Our Brands - The Edvocate](https://www.theedadvocate.org/our-brands): Overview of The Edvocate's brand portfolio including Tech Edvocate and EdRater

## Tech Edvocate Awards

- [The Tech Edvocate Awards - The Edvocate](https://www.theedadvocate.org/tech-edvocate-awards): Annual awards program recognizing excellence in educational technology
- [The Awards Process - The Edvocate](https://www.theedadvocate.org/the-awards-process): Nomination and awards criteria for Tech Edvocate Awards program
- [Finalists and Winners of The 2025 Tech Edvocate Awards - The Edvocate](https://www.theedadvocate.org/finalists-and-winners-of-the-2025-tech-edvocate-awards): 2025 Tech Edvocate Awards winners including OER Commons and TeacherFileBox
- [Finalists and Winners of The 2024 Tech Edvocate Awards - The Edvocate](https://www.theedadvocate.org/finalists-and-winners-of-the-2024-tech-edvocate-awards): 2024 Tech Edvocate Awards results recognizing top edtech products
- [Finalists and Winners of The 2023 Tech Edvocate Awards - The Edvocate](https://www.theedadvocate.org/finalists-and-winners-of-the-2023-tech-edvocate-awards): 2023 Tech Edvocate Awards finalists and winners in education technology
- [Finalists and Winners of The 2021 Tech Edvocate Awards - The Edvocate](https://www.theedadvocate.org/finalists-and-winners-of-the-2021-tech-edvocate-awards): 2021 Tech Edvocate Awards recognizing lesson planning and assessment tools

## EdTech Resources & Guides
